summary: FAIL. Round-1 fixes verified for F-DG0-103..109 (CLOSED_VERIFIED). F-DG0-101 and F-DG0-102 are only partially fixed (OPEN): a whole earlier review round can be deleted undetected, and finding verifications are not bound to the assignment or the freeze, contrary to D-016. New: F-DG0-110 High (finding closure not derived from the reviewer's verification sidecar), F-DG0-111 Medium (write guard bypassed via a planted nested .git), plus Lows F-DG0-112 (hash omits type/mode), F-DG0-113 (CRLF platform dependence) and F-DG0-114 (documentation drift). No secrets; runner, hook fail-closed paths, CI workflow and extraction are sound.
